claude.performance_metric: Veracode divested for ~$950M at ~0 months; no goodwill impairment identified; CA assets retained as anchor of profitable Infrastructure Software segment
claude.rationale: Section 2 documents a whole-company going-concern acquisition in which all tiers (T4 product, T5 process, T6 organization) crossed the boundary together and were re-engineered in tandem under Broadcom's operating model, so no product-vs-process structural mismatch (gap_45=0) and no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0) exist at closing (Section 5 explicitly states "all tiers moved together"). Section 4/P4 states the commercial-process changes altered customer-acceptance terms but was "not an internal product-vs-process integration break," so p4_pathway=0. Section 4/P5 describes go-to-market rationalization as "T5-T6-adjacent friction" documented only at trade-press level and framed as deliberate strategy rather than an integration fracture, and the narrative is acquirer-side financial success, so p5_pathway=0.

gemini.performance_metric: Veracode divested for ~$950 million at close
gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company going-concern acquisition, meaning products, processes, and organization transferred together without structural gaps at closing (gap_45=0, gap_56=0).
